name: How do I choose a bathroom vanity that gives me storage without making the room feel cramped?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a bathroom vanity that gives me storage without making the room feel cramped?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing a vanity can be cosmetic, but changing its size, sink type, plumbing location, countertop, lighting, or wall storage can turn it into a larger coordinated project. The best vanity depends on available clearances, household storage, moisture exposure, cleaning habits, and whether the existing floor will remain visible. Elite Remodeling & Design can incorporate customized storage and fixtures into the broader bathroom layout. Key factors include: - Drawer and door clearance - Counter height and sink configuration - Plumbing access - Wall support for mirrors or cabinets. Inventory what must be stored before choosing cabinet dimensions. Confirm the countertop, sink, faucet, and mirror relationships before ordering custom components.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure clearances first, then match the vanity to storage needs, plumbing access, sink configuration, door and drawer swings, counter height, and mirror placement. A custom or semi-custom option may help, but only after the complete layout is confirmed.
